name: r2mcp-memory
description: r2mcp memory beside the chat: memories related to what you're asking, and at each turn's end a cheap gate and a fork that propose what to remember. Any memory opens in full in a reader

mode.title: Remember mode
mode.description: off: nothing is weighed; shadow: weighed and shown, nothing written; propose: Save/Skip in the pane; auto: written to r2mcp

relatedTurns.title: Related: turns kept
relatedTurns.description: How many of your recent prompts the Related list covers

forkCap.title: Forks per session
forkCap.description: The most forks run in one session; each re-reads the session's prefix from the prompt cache

summaryModel.title: Summary model
summaryModel.description: The model the reader's Summarize button asks for a plain-English version of a memory

jobPrompts.title: Scheduled-job prompts folder
jobPrompts.description: A folder of scheduled jobs' prompt .md files, relative to the project; a session whose first prompt starts with one's # heading is never weighed. Empty for none

gateModel.title: Gate model
gateModel.description: Empty uses the engine's small fast model via classify; or an alias such as haiku
